title: Better Survival
description: QOL Tweaks to Minecraft Including longer reach and more fluid motion
body:
This datapack was merged into Smooth Survival: Early Game Overhaul on May 10th 2026

This datapack enhances your Minecraft experience with essential Quality of Life (QOL) improvements. Build massive structures with ease using an extended reach of up to 9 blocks, and master every jump with fluid motion designed for seamless parkour. Fully compatible with the latest game versions.
